## Wedding catering in Los Angeles (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/weddings)

Weddings Wedding catering in Los Angeles Custom menus and full service for your wedding day. Plated · Family style · Buffet · Stations How it works Inquiry You tell us the date, the place, the guest count and any dietary needs. Consultation We talk through the food, the service style and how the day runs. Custom menu We write a menu for your event and quote it. Event day We handle the food and the service from start to finish. Service styles Plated Courses plated in the kitchen and brought to each seat. Family style Large shared dishes set down on the table. Buffet Guests serve themselves from a set line. Stations Separate stations, cooked and served in front of guests. What is included Menu design A menu written for your event, not picked off a list. Service staff Our staff serve the food through the event. Setup and breakdown We set up our own equipment and break it down when we are done. We handle the food. We do not provide bar service, linens or decor. Dietary needs Menus are built around any dietary needs and allergies. Tell us what they are in your inquiry. Example menus Every menu is custom. These are examples from past events.
